name: app-cream-solution-slide-with-orange-gradient-tile-and-app-icon-corner
title: Cream Solution Slide with Gradient Tile and Icon
whatItIs: A cream board with a top tile of a large light headline about an assistant balancing home tasks, a tall tile of soft yellow to orange gradient, and a tile with a cropped black phone showing an orange gradient app icon beside Photos, Mail and Notes.
whatItMeans: A blank gradient tile acts as a breathing pause between text and product, and the cropped phone shows the icon in the wild.
techniques: Blank gradient tile as a colour rest
Large light headline with a small paragraph
Phone cropped tightly showing the icon among system icons
Warm yellow-orange gradient echoing the icon

vocabulary.definition: A tile with only a gradient, giving the eye a pause.
An icon shown next to real system app icons.
A slide summarising how the product solves the problem.
